source: Football Cartophilic Info Exchange checklist, updated 2026-04-19
notes: Each team gets exactly 20 stickers: #1 emblem, #13 team photo, #2-12 and #14-20 players.
'page' field is null - fill in from your physical album. Pages are 2 per team, so first page of team N is roughly 2*N + intro pages.
Album organizes teams by World Cup group, not alphabetically.
Special FWC stickers, extra stickers, and Coca-Cola regional variants are listed separately.
